It includes inspection, component repair and replacement,reassembly and testing procedures required to return units back into a servicable condition. 3.2 2.0 DEFINITIONS. 3.2.1 CONTRACTOR: Is defined as the successful offeror awarded a contract, orderor issued a project work order. The term "contract" encompasses a contract, an order, or a project work order. 3.2.2 OVERHAUL: An overhauled part is one which has been disassembled, cleaned, inspected, repaired as necessary (by replacing or repairing all components which have been found to exceed limits established by the repair/overhaul manual) reassembled and tested in accordance with the approved repair/overhaul manual listed in this SOW and returned to a Ready for Issue (RFI) condition (Refer to contract schedule for items to be overhauled). 3.2.3 REPAIR: A repaired part is one which has been restored to a Ready for Issue(RFI) condition (by replacing or repairing those components found to be defective, broken, damaged or inoperative during the initial evaluation and troubleshooting phase) and tested in accordance with the approved repair/overhaul manual listed in this SOW (Refer to contract schedule for items to be repaired). 3.3 3.0 SCOPE 3.3.1 GENERAL. The items to be furnished hereunder shall be overhauled, upgraded,repaired, tested, inspected, and accepted in accordance with the terms and conditions specified in this contract. Unless expressly provided Government Furnished Property, including equipment such as fixtures, jigs, dies, patterns, mylars, special tooling, special test equipment, or any other manufacturing aid required for the repair, manufacture, and/or testing of the subject item(s) will not be provided by the Government and shall be the responsibility of the contractor. The foregoing applies notwithstanding any reference to such equipment or the furnishing thereof that may be contained in any drawing, manual, or specification for the contract items. 3.3.2 REPAIR UPGRADE REQUIREMENTS:The contractor shall provide the necessary facility, labor, materials, parts, and test and tooling equipment required to to return the following items to a Ready For Issue (RFI) condition: WHEEL HALF,AIRCRAFT ;A37952; P/N, ;7RH 1630145977780 P8; NSN, ;Available repair manuals, drawings and specifications per p/n requirements; Tech Publications 3.3.3 RFI is defined as that condition allowing the items to perform properly and reliably in an operational environment in a manner they were intended to operate.The contractor must perform all repairs/upgrades at the facility identified within this SOW. Repairs performed by the contractor or subcontractor shall be performed in accordance with the specified drawings and repair manual(s). 3.4 Changes to such manuals used for repairs under this contract, or changes to drawings or specifications used in the manufacture of parts utilized in these repairs, require Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO) approval in accordance with the Configuration Management provisions of this Statement of Work or contract. Under no circumstances should the repair, test, and inspection extend beyond the requirements of this paragraph unless authorized by the Government QAR.In addition, requests for approval of changes to a repair source or repair facility shall be submitted in writing to the PCO prior to making any such change. 3.4.1 Any repairs performed using unapproved changes to such manuals, drawings, specifications, or changes to repair source or facility are done at the contractor's own risk. If the Government disapproves the requested change, the contractor shall replace any delivered items repaired using such unapproved manuals,drawing, specification, repair source or repair facility change. The contractor is not entitled to any equitable adjustment to the contract price or terms based on the Government's disapproval of a requested change to manuals, drawings, specifications, or to a repair source or facility. 3.4.2 References on Drawings and Specifications:For repair and overhaul purposes only. All references to the "prime contractor" or the "actual manufacturer" appearing on the drawings and / or specifications or technical data furnished by the Government shall be read as the "Government Designated Agency" 3.4.3 Process Control Documentation: The contractor shall prepare and maintain repair procedures, and test / inspection information / procedures which shall be made available to the Government for review and approval. The procedures shall include sequential diagrams of processes, as well as the performance specifications to perform the testing / inspection procedures. Those processes shall be frozen after approval of the inspection / Test. 3.4.4 Beyond Economical Repair (BER). An item is BER if the cost of the repair exceeds 75% of the production quantity price to replace the item, current at time of award. This replacement price is for the purposes of BER determinations only, and may not be used or relied on by the offeror in the pricing of the repairs required by this contract. title: Electronic Safe and Arm Devices (ESAD)
description: The U.S Army Contracting Command-Rock Island at Picatinny, on behalf of the Department of War (DoW) Fuze Integrated Product Team (IPT) is seeking feedback from industry on Continental United States (CONUS) sources and information regarding the existing capability to manufacture Electronic Safe and Arm Devices (ESAD) fuzes for munitions, as well as Ignition Safety Devices (ISDs) for rocket motors. DISCLAIMER: THIS RFI IS FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL, NOR AS AN OBLIGATION ON THE PART OF THE GOVERNMENT. THE GOVERNMENT DOES NOT INTEND TO AWARD A CONTRACT ON THE BASIS OF THIS RFI OR REIMBURSE ANY CONTRACTORS FOR ANY INFORMATION OR ADMINISTRATIVE COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH RESPONDING TO THIS NOTIFICATION. PARTICIPATION IN THIS EFFORT IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY AND ANY OF THE INFORMATION STATED ABOVE IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE. THE GOVERNMENT INTENDS TO USE THE INFORMATION RECEIVED TO DEVELOP A WHITEPAPER AND INVESTMENT STRATEGY TO SUPPORT THE SCALE-UP NECESSARY TO EXPAND AND SECURE THE DOMESTIC ELECTRONIC FUZING AND IGNITION SYSTEMS INDUSTRIAL BASE. THE GOVERNMENT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO USE ANY NON-PROPRIETARY INFORMATION IN ANY RESULTANT SOLICITATION(S). PROPRIETARY INFORMATION SHOULD BE MARKED AS SUCH. IF A FORMAL SOLICITATION IS GENERATED AT A LATER DATE, THE GOVERNMENT WILL PUBLISH A SOLICITATION NOTICE. DESCRIPTION: The Government is specifically seeking to understand the industrial base's capacity to scale production in response to emerging high-rate defense requirements. These include supporting Weaponized Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) for Drone Dominance, Launched Effects (LE), Counter-UAS (cUAS) technologies, low-cost/high-rate systems, alongside the increased production demand for existing munition systems. To enable this scalability, the Government must identify critical manufacturing, testing, and component-level supply chain bottlenecks, specifically concerning high-voltage firing capacitors, solid-state high-voltage switches, and In-Line Initiators (ILI) to include Explosive Foil Initiators (EFIs) / Low Energy Exploding Foil Initiators (LEEFIs) / Exploding Foil Deflagrating Initiators (EFDIs). The PSC code is 1390 � Fuzes and Primers RESPONSE REQUIREMENTS: The U.S. Government is requesting information from all interested CONUS sources having relevant ESAD and ISD manufacturing, assembly, energetic loading/integration, and testing capabilities. Respondents shall describe their prior experience, existing facility capabilities, relevant equipment, and personnel. title: DoDNet Program Management Office (PMO) Support
description: This effort is in support of the Department of Defense Network (DoDNet) Program Management Office (PMO) was created in response to a memo that was published on 15 August 2019 by the Deputy Secretary of Defense titled �Fourth Estate Network Optimization Execution Guidance,� which gave DISA the authority, as of 1 October 2019, to direct the transition of each Defense Agency and Field Activity (DAFA) from disparate, legacy Common Use IT services and assets into the Single Service Provider (SSP) shared network environment. The shared network was planned to reduce redundant IT costs, enhance cybersecurity posture, and standardize support services across the 4th Estate. The contractor shall provide critical support to the DODNet PMO with the management of transitioning DAFAs onto the SSP shared network environment and serves as the primary integrator, working with the Government team�s Project Managers and Engineers to facilitate requirements documents necessary for the Program Review Board (PRB). The contractor shall provide services to facilitate the Engineering Review Board (ERB) and Operational Revie Board (ORB) making sure projects fit within the larger DoDNet portfolio. These actions fall within the DoDNet Systems Engineering Framework (DSEF) process which was built and facilitated by Solvtek during the current contract Period of Performance. Knowledge transfer of the DSEF process over to the Government is anticipated for FY27 and is linked to the J6/DoDNet program�s workforce expansion efforts. This proposed action is necessary to prevent an unacceptable break in critical services while the follow-on competitive acquisition, DoDNet Program Management Office (PMO) Support is finalized and awarded. The anticipated period of performance for this bridge contract is 16 December 2026 through 15 December 2027.

title: UT NP ARCH 100(2) Bridges on Delicate Arch Road
description: PROJECT NUMBER: UT NP ARCH 100(2) PROJECT NAME: Bridges on Delicate Arch Road PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Delicate Arch Road (DAR) is within Arches National Park (Park) and provides access to Delicate Arch. DAR is a functional class 1 roadway (Principal Park Road) and is heavily traveled by visitors and often congested during periods with moderate-to-high levels of visitation. DAR crosses three low-gradient ephemeral washes (Salt Valley Wash, Salt Wash, and Winter Camp Wash) near their confluence in the Salt Wash Basin downstream of Wolfe Ranch. Culverts installed during original road construction in the mid-1990s and during subsequent upgrades are inadequate to allow unobstructed stream flow and sediment transport downstream. This existing condition produces flooding and sediment deposition, which creates unsafe conditions for visitors, triggers road closures, potentially strands Park visitors, diminishes visitor experience of the Park, and generates high operational costs associated with traffic management, visitor safety, and cleanup operations. SCOPE OF THE WORK: This project will be designated as Reconstruction (4R) with one segment of restoration (3R), and will design and construct 100� span concrete bridges at the Salt Valley Wash, Salt Wash, and Winter Camp Wash. The DA roadway profile at each Wash will be raised to accommodate a 10-year design frequency and allow a medium-sized excavator to access each wash. The DA will be realigned at the Salt Valley wash, moving the roadway and new bridge location to the north of the existing roadway and drainage crossing. The remaining 3R sections of the roadway will receive full depth reclamation (FDR) or removal of pavement, including all parking areas, followed by a 4-inch pavement overlay. title: Alaska Construction IDIQ Sources Sought
description: SOURCES SOUGHT Construction Services for General Services Administration (GSA), Public Buildings Service (PBS) in Alaska Sources Sought Response Date: November 19th, 2026 1:00 PM PT The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. This Sources Sought Notice is a market research tool being utilized to determine interest and capability of potential sources prior to issuing a formal solicitation, as the solicitation is not available at this time. This IS NOT a Request for Offerors or Proposals. This notice does not represent a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract, nor does it restrict the Government to a particular acquisition approach. This is a Sources Sought Announcement for planning purposes only. Market research is being conducted to determine if there are businesses with the requisite capabilities and experience to perform the required work. In addition, this market research is to determine if there are respondents that qualify under one or more socio-economic indicators, including but not limited to, small business, woman-owned business, Women Owned Small business (WOSB), Economically Disadvantaged Women Owned Small business (EDWOSB), Veteran Owned Small business, Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small business, SBA Certified Small Disadvantaged business, SBA Certified 8(a) Firm, SBA Certified HUBZone Firm. The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) anticipates procuring the services of multiple contractors to perform Construction Services in the nature of repair and alteration of real property. The nature of the service is to support the government to successfully accomplish the small project repair and alteration programs in the locations listed in this notice. It is the intention of GSA to award a multiple contractor, Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract. Description of Services: The contractor shall act as general contractor for small repair and alteration of real property in federal buildings (NAICS 236220), of both interior space and exterior building envelope and grounds. The contractor�s roles and responsibilities may include: design, demolition, abatement, repair and alteration of interior space including but not limited to, carpentry, woods and plastics, drywall, insulation, doors and openings, finishes, paint, bathroom fixtures, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, fire/life/safety equipment, specialized security equipment, fencing, windows, outdoor lighting. Value-added services such as service recommendations, additional coordination, and liaison with third parties may be required. The construction services will be performed in, but not limited to, federally owned facilities throughout Alaska. Task orders may occasionally require construction activities in privately owned leased facilities, however it is anticipated that the majority of construction will take place in federally owned facilities. The Government is considering structuring the IDIQ contracts to provide order-level flexibility for task orders to be placed that are either commercial or non-commercial. The construction services shall comply with GSA�s Core Building Standards, as well as all applicable engineering, architectural and construction standards and codes, to be fully described in any resulting solicitation. Inclusions: The work requirements will include design-build work and construction services as defined in RFO Part 2 and Part 36. The work requirements include Construction Wage Rate Act [formerly Davis-Bacon Act]. Commercial contracting approaches from RFO Part 12 will also be implemented. Exclusions: This Sources Sought does not include stand-alone architect-engineer (A-E) services as defined in the Brooks Act and RFO (FAR) Parts 2 and 36; however, some may require the contractor to provide design services in addition to construction services. This Sources Sought does not include construction management services of other separate projects. If interested in responding to this Sources Sought, please respond by completing and submitting the GSA Alaska Construction IDIQ Sources Sought Questionnaire no later than 1:00pm Pacific Time on Thursday, November 19th, 2026. NO TELEPHONE CALLS WILL BE ACCEPTED. QUESTIONS ARE NOT PERMITTED. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL OR SOLICITATION.

title: Request For Proposal (RFP) for NASA Agency-wide Supply of Liquid and Gaseous Helium
description: UPDATE 10/20/2026 The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) John F. Kennedy Space Center is pleased to release the 2027 NASA Agency-wide Supply of Liquid and Gaseous Helium opt-in opportunity as described in the original Helium Request for Proposal (RFP), Sections 2.10, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in, and 2.10.1, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in After Award. The Helium RFP was issued on December 21, 2024, and the original solicitation (as revised) remains open throughout the ordering period through the use of innovative provisions as prescribed in Section 2.10.1, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in After Award. The Helium contract's ordering period remains valid through September 30, 2030. The RFP has resulted in the award of four fixed-price indefinite delivery (ID) requirements contracts to supply liquid and gaseous helium in support of operations at agency centers and facilities across the United States. Awards were made to the following companies: Airgas USA LLC (South), Airgas USA LLC (West), Linde, Inc., and Messer LLC. Each year during the life of the solicitation and at the time established via synopsis, the Government will accept proposals from new entrants for each IDIQ subCLIN location and the Government will also accept proposals from existing helium contractors for each additional IDIQ subCLIN location. A new entrant is a company that does not currently hold a NASA liquid and gaseous helium contract. The Government will evaluate the proposals to determine technical acceptability for a specific NASA location. Upon the Government's determination of technical acceptability, a contract (for new entrants) or contract modification (for existing helium Contractors) will be executed to add the Contractor to the IDIQ CLIN Pool for the specific NASA location. This initiative seeks to secure a mix of single-award Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts and/or Other Transactions (OTs) to streamline the procurement, testing, fielding, and lifecycle sustainment of both legacy systems and emerging transport hardware and software. Focused on supporting Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2), the effort aims to deliver highly secure�National Security Agency (NSA) High Assurance certified or Sensitive but Unclassified - Encrypted (SBU-E) qualified�resilient, and interoperable communication systems. To counter future cryptographic threats, the framework is seeking capable vendors to provide a plan for incorporating Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) compliant algorithms and achieving National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) validation by 31 December 2030, ensuring robust data protection and mission command resilience in contested joint and coalition environments. 2. title: Gathright Dam Motor Control Center Electrical Repairs in Covington, Virginia
description: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS. THERE WILL NOT BE A SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATIONS, NOR DRAWINGS AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers � Norfolk District is anticipating a future procurement for a firm-fixed-price construction contract for the Gathright Dam Motor Control Center Electrical Repairs Project in Covington, Virginia. Description of Work: The United States Army Corps of Engineers, Norfolk District, is seeking eligible firms capable of performing motor power, control, and instrumentation electrical renovations for the intake tower located at Gathright Dam, Virginia. The primary electrical scope entails the replacement of existing 480-volt motor control centers (designated MCC2 and MCC3) with new motor control centers complete with starters, controls, incoming and outgoing feeders, incoming and outgoing conduits, control circuits, and field wiring. Incidental work includes contractor field verification of conduit pathways, replacement of conduits directly affected by equipment replacements or compromised by corrosion in accordance with the conduit and cable schedule, and the replacement in-kind of transformer XFMR-3. In addition, the project requires the comprehensive replacement and modernization of the facility control system. Work includes the demolition of existing control panels, power panels, and communication panels, followed by the installation of new Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) panels, Remote Input/Output (RIO) panels, Human-Machine Interface (HMI) screens, and all associated network wiring, cabling, and conduit infrastructure. Work to include replacement of the instrumentation for the wet well gate displacement (linear displacement sensors) to be tied into the new control system and updates to lighting to manage the nearing end-of-life of the old metal-halide high bay lights and fluorescent wallpack lights. The contractor will also be responsible for programming the new PLCs and reprogramming the existing Sutron system. All operations must be carefully phased and coordinated, as facility buildings will remain occupied throughout the duration of contract performance. There is also a bid option for a warehouse-style high bay luminaire lifting mechanism at a low-enough power-per-luminaire to tie into the associated existing lighting circuit. The estimated construction price range for this project is between $1,000,000.00 and $5,000,000.00. NAICS Code 238210, Electrical Contractors and Oher Wiring Installation Contractors, applies to this project with a small business size standard of $19,000,000.00. PSC J061, Maintenance, Repair, and Rebuilding of Equipment � Electric Wire and Power Distribution Equipment, applies to this project. The Government is not obligated to and will not pay for any information received from potential sources as a result of this sources sought. The official synopsis citing the solicitation number will be issued on System for Award Management (SAM) at www.sam.gov. title: BRACE, AIRCRAFT GROUND SERVICING
description: SYNOPSIS: #N68335-26-Q-1194 BRACE, AIRCRAFT GROUND SERVICING Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division - F/A-18F and EA-18G Royal Australian Air Force Program The Naval Air Warfare Center, Aircraft Division (NAWCAD) Lakehurst, NJ intends to negotiate on a sole source basis with Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation (CAGE: 76823) for the BRACE, AIRCRAFT GROUND SERVICING (Part Number (P/N): 74D110613-1007, National Stock Number (NSN): 1730-01-473-3572) in support of the Royal Australian Airforce (RAAF) F/A-18F & EA-18G Program. This order will procure four (4) BRACE, AIRCRAFT GROUND SERVICING. The support is necessary to hold the stabilizer in a stable, trim position or a 22-degree leading-edge-down position during various maintenance activities, such as engine or stabilizer removal and replacement. The recommended solution is the Brace, Aircraft Ground Servicing (P/N: 74D110613-1007) Horizontal Stabilizer Support, which is designed to be usable on both the right and left sides of the aircraft. A key feature is a tension bolt that fails during an overload condition, allowing the stabilizer to rotate freely and prevent damage. Northrop Grumman Systems Corporation, as the Original Equipment Manufacturer of the BRACE, AIRCRAFT GROUND SERVICING, is the only source with the requisite knowledge, technical experience, and production-level data to produce these components. The components being procured are integral to hold the stabilizer in a stable, trim position or a 22-degree leading-edge-down position during various maintenance activities and are critical to maintaining operational readiness. The Government intends to solicit and negotiate this requirement under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 2304(c)(1), FAR 6.302-1 - Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. THIS NOTICE IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. However, the Government will consider all responses received within fifteen days after the date of publication of this synopsis. title: John Day Below-the-Hook Lifting Devices Repair and Recertification
description: 1. General. This is a SOURCES SOUGHT for John Day Below-the-Hook Lifting Devices Repair and Recertification (Commercial Services Contract) and is for informational/market research purposes only. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL, QUOTATION OR BID, NOR A SYNOPSIS OF A PROPOSED CONTRACT ACTION. This Sources Sought is to gain knowledge of the interest, capabilities, and qualifications of industry so the government can make informed business decisions. We are seeking responses from both large and small business members of industry to include: Small Business, Small Disadvantaged Businesses to include 8(a) firms, Historically Underutilized Business Zones (HUBZone), Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) to include Economically Disadvantaged Women-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small business (SDVOSB) and Veteran Owned Small Business (VOSB). All interested parties are highly encouraged to respond. Reponses to this Sources Sought announcement will be used by the Government to make business decisions and to inform potential future solicitations. The North American Industrial Classification Code (NAICS) for this requirement is: 811310 � Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment (except Automotive and Electronic) Repair and Maintenance. PSC is J039 � Maintenance, Repair, and Rebuilding of Equipment�Materials Handling Equipment. The related size standard is: $12.5 Million Formal Sources Sought Response Due � November 19, 2026 at 200PM PT. Number and Type of Contracts: NWP contemplates awarding one (1) firm fixed priced, commercial service contract. 2. Project Background. The Government conducted visual and non-destructive testing inspections on several Below-the-Hook lifting devices at the powerhouse at John Day Dam in Rufus, Oregon. These inspections were performed from January 26 to January 28, 2026, in accordance with AWS D1.1 2025 and ASTM E709 standards. The goal was to assess the structural integrity of the powerhouse�s overhead lifting devices. The Government inspection yielded several cracks in five lifting devices and removed them from service. 3. Project Scope. The scope of this project involves the comprehensive inspection, repair, and re-certification of existing Below-the-Hook (BTH) lifting devices for the John Day Dam powerhouse bridge crane identified in the inspection report. Cracks were found in the following lifting devices: 1 - 590 Ton Spreader Beam 2 - 310 Ton Spreader Beams 1 - Lifting Device for Main & Intermediate Shafts, 1 - Lifting Device for the Runner at the Contractor�s facility. The work required, but is not limited to: Transport: Transfer of devices to off site Contractor shop for repair and load testing. Inspection and Inventory: Creating a complete inventory and performing non-destructive examination (NDE) on all lifting devices and their components before any repairs. Weld Repair: Repairing approximately 55 inches of known weld defects in structural penetration welds. Removal of Defect Fabrication Welds: Removal of fabrication or tack welds with defects. Load Testing: Load testing the devices at 125% of their rated capacity, followed by additional non-destructive examination. Finishing and Documentation: Stripping and repainting the devices, providing new nameplates and safety labels. Delivery: Delivering the fully repaired, tested, and certified lifting devices back to the John Day Powerhouse. The repairs should follow AWS D1.1 and ASTM E709 methods and inspection standards to correct the identified deficiencies and restore the equipment to safe operational standards. The Government will assist the loading and unloading of the lifting devices to and from the Contractor�s truck using the powerhouse gantry crane. The Contractor will abate and remove lead paint at the cracks and spot repaint with a government approved paint system. 4. Submission Instructions. Formal responses to this Sources Sought notice must be submitted electronically (via email) with SUBJECT: Sources Sought � JD Overhead Lifting Devices Repair. Please email to Scarlett Millman, Contracting Specialist, at Scarlett.J.Millman@usace.army.mil and Nicole Adams, Contracting Officer, at nicole.a.adams@usace.army.mil, before November 19, 2026 at 1200PM PT. Interested parties� responses to this Sources Sought shall be limited to four (4) pages and shall include the following information: Firm's name, address, point of contact, phone number, e-mail address, CAGE and Unique Entity ID. Firm's business category and size: Large Business (include summary of small business participation metrics), Small Business, Small Disadvantaged Businesses to include 8(a) firms, Historically Underutilized Business Zones (HUBZone), Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) to include Economically Disadvantaged Women-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small business (SDVOSB) and at the subcontracting level, Veteran Owned Small Business (VOSB). An explanation of the prime firm�s capabilities, special qualifications/certifications and equipment and describe the work to be self-performed as it pertains to the proposed work outlined in the Project Scope. A description of work performed for similar projects, with consideration to the size of the lifting devices, potential lead paint, meeting the special qualifications required for this effort, and working on a federal contract. To be considered for a potential set aside or sole source strategy, it is recommended contractors provide a minimum of one (1) and maximum of three (3) projects similar to the project. These project examples should be similar in size, scope and complexity to the work described in the Project Scope Section of this notice. Provide a description of each project (to include pertinent qualitative and quantitative information about featured scope elements), and include the following: Project Title Contract Number Contract award date Customer name, phone number and email address Prime or Subcontractor Initial contract dollar value Final contract dollar value Initial contract completion date Final contract completion date Customer satisfaction Firm's Joint Venture information if applicable - existing and potential. Firm's interest and the likelihood in bidding on the solicitation when it is issued. (Refer to planned advertisement and performance dates) Recommendation on pricing and payment for the Welding portion of the contract (numerous Options, T&M CLINs, etc.) 5. Disclaimer and Important Notes. a. This notice does not obligate the Government to award a contract. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this Sources Sought or any follow up information. The Government reserves the right to use information provided by respondents for any purpose deemed necessary and legally appropriate. Any organization responding to this notice should ensure that its response is complete and sufficiently detailed to allow the Government to determine the organization's capabilities to perform the work. Respondents are advised that the Government is under no obligation to acknowledge receipt of the information received or to provide feedback to respondents with respect to any information submitted. b. All interested firms must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at https://www.sam.gov to have size status considered. You must remain current for the duration of the source selection process to be eligible for award of a Government contract.

title: J--Notice of Intent to Sole Source - SaniStar Remote Off-Grid Kiosk Maintenance an
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE SaniStar Remote Off-Grid Kiosk Maintenance and Technical Support Description The U.S. Department of the Interior (DOI), Bureau of Land Management (BLM), Division of Recreation and Visitor Services, intends to establish a single-supplier Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) with SaniStar LLC for maintenance, repair, replacement parts, proprietary software support, and related technical services associated with existing SaniStar Remote Off-Grid Kiosk (ROK) systems deployed at BLM recreation sites. The proposed BPA will support the continued operation of automated fee collection systems used to process electronic recreation fee payments in remote and off-grid environments. The anticipated ordering period is five years, with individual purchases made as requirements arise. Description of Requirement The anticipated requirement includes the following services and supplies associated with existing SaniStar ROK systems: Preventive and corrective maintenance. Technical troubleshooting, equipment diagnostics, and remote support. Proprietary software maintenance, firmware updates, and security patches. Replacement parts and repair of integrated kiosk components. Maintenance and support of electronic payment processing equipment, ticket printers, power systems, and communication devices. System configuration, synchronization, and related operational support necessary to maintain electronic recreation fee collection. Basis for Sole-Source Consideration The Bureau of Land Management intends to establish a single-supplier BPA with SaniStar LLC pursuant to FAR 13.303-2(c)(2) for recurring maintenance, repair, replacement parts, proprietary software support, and related technical services associated with existing SaniStar ROK systems. Although the anticipated aggregate value of the BPA exceeds the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT), individual purchases under the BPA are expected to remain at or below the applicable SAT and will be conducted in accordance with FAR Part 13, including applicable competition requirements. Based on preliminary market research, the Government believes SaniStar LLC may be the only source reasonably available to provide certain proprietary maintenance and technical support services necessary to maintain the existing kiosk infrastructure. These services involve manufacturer-controlled software, firmware, diagnostic capabilities, payment processing configurations, and integrated hardware components. The Government is providing this notice to determine whether other responsible sources possess the capability to satisfy the requirement. Interested Sources and Response Instructions This notice is not a request for competitive quotations or proposals. Interested parties that believe they possess the capability to satisfy the Government's requirements may submit a written capability statement for consideration. Capability statements should demonstrate the respondent's ability to provide maintenance, repair, replacement components, proprietary software support, and related technical services for existing SaniStar ROK systems, including the ability to obtain any necessary access to manufacturer-controlled software, diagnostic tools, and technical resources. Interested parties shall submit their written capability statements electronically to: Antoinette Nelson Contracting Officer Department of Interior: BLM Division Email: antoinette_nelson@ios.doi.gov Response Deadline: November 19, 2026, at 3:00 PM Mountain Standard Time (MST). All timely responses will be reviewed and considered by the Government. A determination not to compete the proposed acquisition, based on responses received, is solely within the discretion of the Government, consistent with applicable acquisition requirements. Additional Information This notice is for informational purposes and does not constitute a request for quotations or proposals, an award, authorization to proceed, or a commitment by the Government to enter into a contract. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs incurred in preparing or submitting capability statements.

title: Germany – Installation of doors and windows and related components – Eibenkamp 1 - Tragwerk und Gebäudehülle BIM
description: SBH | Schulbau Hamburg hat als Landesbetrieb der Freien und Hansestadt Hamburg (nachstehend SBH genannt) die Aufgabe, die Schulimmobilien unter Berücksichtigung der schulischen Belange nach wirtschaftlichen Grundsätzen zu planen, zu bauen, zu unterhalten und zu bewirtschaften und die mehr als 400 Schulen an die Behörde für Schule und Berufsbildung (BSB) zu vermieten. --------------- Auf dem Grundstück Eibenkamp 1, 22559 Hamburg errichtet Schulbau Hamburg für die Stadtteilschule und das Gymnasium Rissen ein gemeinsames Oberstufenhaus. Das Gebäude soll aufgrund seiner Lage am Landschaftsschutzgebet als nachhaltig innovativer Holzbau mit offenen Lernflächen, Gemeinschaftsflächen und einer Einfeld-Sporthalle realisiert werden. Das Gebäude fällt in die Gebäudeklasse 3 nach HBauO. Eine Baugenehmigung (Zustimmung) liegt vor. Die bautechnischen Nachweise zu Wärmeschutz, Schallschutz und Brandschutz werden für die Angebotsphase zur Verfügung gestellt. Der Standsicherheitsnachweis befindet sich in Prüfung. Es gelten die Anforderungen der LBBau in der Fassung von 2023. Die Planung des Gebäudes erfolgte nach der BIM-Methode. Das Baufeld ist bereits komplett geräumt, frei von Kampfmitteln und gemäß den gesetzlichen Anforderungen zum Schutz von Flora und Fauna hergerichtet. Die Gründung des Neubaus erfolgt als Flachgründung mit einer 35 cm dicken Stahlbeton-Sohlplatte und einer umlaufenden Fundamentverdickung. Das konstruktive Prinzip sieht für das Gebäude ein Holz-Skelett-Tragwerk mit aussteifenden BSP-Massivholz-Wandscheiben vor. Die Geschossdecken werden als Holzbetonverbunddecke und als BSP-Massivholzdecke, in Teilbereichen als Rippendecke ausgeführt. Dachdecken werden als weit gespannte Hohldecke über der Sporthalle und als BSP-Massivholzdecke oder Rippendecke konstruiert. Außenliegende Rettungsbalkone werden als StB-Fertigteilplatten mit Stahlstützen geplant. Auf dem extensiven Gründach soll eine PV-Anlage durch einen Drittanbieter errichtet werden. Die opaken Außenwände erhalten eine vorgehängte hinterlüftete Verkleidung aus Faserzement-Fassadenplatten mit sichtbarer Befestigung. Die Fenster werden als Holz-Alu-Elemente ausgeführt mit integrierten Außentüren auf die Rettungsbalkone und integrierten Lüftungsgittern. Außentüren an Haupt- und Nebeneingängen sind als Stahl-Rohrrahmentüren mit Glasfüllung geplant. --------------- Hier: Tragwerk und Gebäudehülle --------------- - Baustelleneinrichtung - Erdarbeiten - Stahlbetonbauarbeiten - Holzbau - Laubengänge - Dach - Fassade - Fenster - Metallbau Hinweis: Beim Vergabeverfahren für Tragwerk und Gebäudehülle des Neubaus ist die Einreichung von Nebenangeboten in Verbindung mit dem Hauptangebot möglich. Nebenangebote sind nur in den Bereichen des LV möglich, wo dies nicht durch die folgende Formulierung „(kein Nebenangebot möglich)“ ausgeschlossen ist. Nebenangebote in den Bereichen, in denen diese nicht zugelassen sind, stellen unzulässige Änderungen an den Vergabeunterlagen dar und führen zwingend zum Ausschluss. Nebenangebote sind auf einer besonderen Anlage anzugeben und deutlich zu kennzeichnen. Werden Nebenangebote nicht auf besonderer Anlage angegeben und deutlich gekennzeichnet, führt dieser Verstoß gegen § 13 EU Abs. 3 Satz 2 VOB/A zwingend zum Ausschluss.

description: Die Gemeinde Münster beabsichtigt das vorhanden Gebäude der katholische Kita St. Michael / Familienzentrum (infolge „KiTa“ genannt) abzureißen und als Ersatzneubau auf dem bestehenden Grundstück Gerhart-Hauptmann-Straße 11, 64839 Münster (Hessen); Gemarkung Münster, Flur 18, Flurstücke 616/3 (derzeitiges Grundstück der Kita), sowie den Flurstücken 606/2 (Kinderspielplatz) und 604 (Vorplatz) insgesamt neu zu errichten und hierbei Platz für 4 Kita-Gruppen und ein Familienzentrum zu schaffen. title: Germany – Sirens – Erweiterung des Sirenensystem der Stadt Bad Münstereifel
description: Die Stadt Bad Münstereifel erweitert ihr Sirenensystem zur Warnung der Bevölkerung im Katastrophenfall zu erneuern. Hierfür wurde ein Beschallungsplan erstellt und die notwendigen Sirenenstandorte wurden festgelegt. Ebenso wurde im vorliegenden fachtechnischen Konzept die notwendigen technischen Anforderungen an die einzelnen Komponenten des Sirenensystems beschrieben. Diese Dokumentation ist als Anhang dieser Leistungsbeschreibung beigefügt. Das fachtechnische Konzept verfolgt das Ziel, eine sachgerechte, funktionelle und wirtschaftliche Lösung umzusetzen. Der Bieter hat das bestehende Sirenenwarnsystem zu erneuern und um weitere Standorte zu ergänzen. Die angebotenen Sirenen und Sirenensteuerempfänger (POCSAG und Tetra-BOS) müssen entsprechend den technischen Rahmenbedingungen der Förderung des Sonderförderprogramm Sirenen des Bundes förderfähig sein. Außerdem muss das Sirenenwarnsystem über eine Schnittstelle zum modularen Warnsystem (MoWaS) des Bundesamts für Bevölkerungsschutz und Katastrophenhilfe (BBK) verfügen. Für den Betrieb der TETRA-Sirenensteuerempfänger sind die Vorgaben der BDBOS und der Autorisierten Stelle in Nordrhein-Westfalen einzuhalten. Die Arbeiten für jeden Standort sind in Form eines Pauschalpreises anzubieten. Die jeweiligen Preise werden im angehangenen Preisblatt eingetragen. Trotz der sorgfältigen Planung, ist nicht auszuschließen, dass sich im Rahmen der Montagearbeiten herausstellt, dass die Tragfähigkeiten der Sirenenköpfe in einzelnen Dachstühlen oder Masten nicht gegeben ist bzw. die Standsicherheit der Fundamente einer Mastanlage nicht gewährleistet werden kann. Aus diesem Grund sind in den Preispositionen nicht bestimmt anfallende Leistungen aufgeführt. Diese Maßnahme wird gefördert durch das Sirenenförderprogramm 2.0 und Sirenenförderprogramm NRW.

title: Germany – Engineering services – AZV - Neubau der Kläranlage Untere Ahr in Remagen: Vermessungsleistungen
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Erbringung übergeordneter vermessungstechnischer Leistungen für das Bauvorhaben: Neubau der Kläranlage Untere Ahr Die Leistungen umfassen insbesondere die vermessungstechnische Beratung, die Ein-richtung und Unterhaltung eines einheitlichen Lage- und Höhenbezugssystems, das vermessungstechnische Qualitätsmanagement, baubegleitende Kontroll- und Überwachungsmessungen, Deformations- und Setzungsmessungen, die baubegleitende Erfassung wesentlicher Bestandsdaten sowie die abschließende Bestandsvermessung als Grundlage für Dokumentation, Abnahme, Betreiberunterlagen und die Übergabe an die CAD-/GIS-/BIM-verantwortlichen Projektbeteiligten. Die Leistungen sind als unabhängige Bauherrenvermessung zu verstehen. Sie dienen nicht der operativen Bauabsteckung für die ausführenden Unternehmen, sondern der Kontrolle, Qualitätssicherung, Dokumentation und Koordination der vermessungs-technischen Belange des Auftraggebers. Ziel der zu vergebenden Leistung ist die Sicherstellung eines einheitlichen, widerspruchsfreien und prüfbaren vermessungstechnischen Raumbezugs über alle Planungs-, Bau- und Dokumentationsprozesse hinweg. Der Auftragnehmer hat insbesondere sicherzustellen, dass: - ein verbindliches Lage-, Höhen-, Bezugs- und Benennungssystem für alle Projektbeteiligten vorliegt, - ein dauerhaft nutzbares und ausreichend genaues Festpunktfeld eingerichtet und überwacht wird, - die Vermessungsleistungen der ausführenden Unternehmen plausibilisiert und stichprobenartig kontrolliert werden, - kritische Bauwerke und Bauteile vermessungstechnisch überwacht werden, - Setzungen, Verschiebungen und Deformationen frühzeitig erkannt und dokumentiert werden, - verdeckt liegende oder später nicht mehr zugängliche Anlagen baubegleitend erfasst werden, - die Schlussvermessung als belastbare Grundlage für Bestandspläne, Bestands-dokumentation und ggf. BIM-Modellaktualisierung bereitgestellt wird.

title: Germany – Architectural and related services – Stadtwerke Essen AG: EU-weites Vergabeverfahren "Planung des Wärmenetzes" (Los 4)
description: Die Stadt Essen verfolgt das strategische Ziel, bis spätestens 2045 Klimaneutralität zu erreichen. Ein zentraler Baustein dieses Transformationsprozesses ist die Dekarbonisierung der Wärmeversorgung. Im Gebiet Essen-Überruhr/Burgaltendorf bestehen derzeit ungenutzte Potenziale für die Nutzung erneuerbarer Energiequellen. Der aktuelle Wärmebedarf von ca. 98,6 GWh/a verteilt sich auf rund 13.110 Wohneinheiten, wobei Erdgas mit einem Anteil von etwa 58 % gegenwärtig die dominierende Versorgungsart darstellt. Weitere 26 % des Bedarfs sind derzeit nicht eindeutig zugeordnet und entfallen auf nicht leitungsgebundene Energieträger. Um die Klimaziele zu erreichen und eine nachhaltige Wärmeversorgung sicherzustellen, hat die Stadtwerke Essen Machbarkeitsstudien durchgeführt. Diese zeigen, dass die Versorgung der Grund- und Mittellast künftig durch die Nutzung von Grubenwasser, Flusswasser und Klarwasser grundsätzlich gewährleistet werden kann. Im Rahmen der Machbarkeitsstudie wurden darüber hinaus Flusswasser und Klarwasser als potenzielle Wärmequellen untersucht; diese werden im weiteren Projektverlauf jedoch nicht weiterverfolgt. Als einzige natürliche Wärmequelle verbleibt das Grubenwasser der Zeche Heinrich. Die erzeugte Wärmemenge soll über ein neu zu errichtendes Wärmenetz verteilt werden, das im Endausbau rund 4.137 Gebäude versorgen wird. Die Planung und Errichtung des neuen Niedertemperaturwärmenetzes wird im Rahmen des Förderprogramms des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Klimaschutz "Bundesförderung für effiziente Wärmenetze (BEW-Modul 1, Leistungsphasen 2-4)" durchgeführt. Ziel ist die anschließende Umsetzung des Vorhabens im BEW-Modul 2 (Bau). Die Wirksamkeit dieses Vertrages steht unter der aufschiebenden Bedingung, dass ein Fördermittelbescheid über die Bewilligung der beantragten Fördermittel für das BEW1-Modul in einer Höhe erteilt wurde, die nach den verbindlichen Fördermittelbedingungen die Finanzierung des Projektes für das BEW1-Modul sichert. Es wird darauf hingewiesen, dass eine Aufhebung des Vergabeverfahrens erfolgen kann, sofern die Auftraggeberin die Fördermittel für die Durchführung des Gesamtprojekts nicht erhalten sollte. Gemäß Regelprozess der Auftraggeberin erfolgt die Mittelfreigabe für den Wirtschaftsplan 2027 im letzten Quartal 2026. Die Mittelfreigabe ist Voraussetzung für die Durchführung des Vergabeverfahrens über den Teilnahmewettbewerb hinaus. Für den Fall, dass die Mittelfreigabe nicht erfolgen würde, behält sich die Auftraggeberin die Aufhebung des Vergabeverfahrens vor. Aktuell liegt noch keine Gestattung für die Errichtung des Niedertemperaturwärmenetzes vor. Der Gestattungsantrag wurde eingereicht.

description: Die Landeshauptstadt Saarbrücken beabsichtigt in verkehrsgünstiger, grenznaher Lage zu Frankreich ein neues, integriertes, lebenswertes Stadtquartier (23,5 ha Größe) zu entwickeln, das eine städtebauliche Ergänzung insbesondere mit Wohnen und Gewerbe, ergänzt durch Dienstleistung, Nahversorgung und adäquate Freiraumstrukturen zu der angrenzenden Großwohnsiedlung "Folsterhöhe" aus den 1960er Jahren darstellt. Ziel des interaktiven, lösungsorientierten wettbewerblichen Dialogs ist es daher, für diese einerseits verkehrsoptimale, potenzielle Wohn- und Gewerbefläche mit andererseits vorhandenen schützenswerten Nutzungen und freiräumlichen Strukturen der Stadtrandlage, aber auch städtebaulichen Missständen ein unter sozialen, ökologischen aber auch wirtschaftlichen Aspekten betreffendes, städtebauliches Konzept als Grundlage für die weiteren Planungsschritte zu entwickeln. Das Verfahren zur Erarbeitung einer städtebaulichen und freiraumplanerischen Lösung wird als Wettbewerblicher Dialog nach § 18 Abs. 6 VgV in voraussichtlich zwei Dialogrunden (voraussichtlich 4 Dialogsitzungen) durchgeführt. Die Auftraggeberin behält sich ferner vor, den Dialog in weiteren aufeinander folgenden Phasen zu führen. Dem Wettbewerblichen Dialog ist ein EU-weiter, offener Teilnahmewettbewerb mit Eignungs- und Referenzprüfung vorgeschaltet. In der Dialogphase sollen die Teilnehmer unter Berücksichtigung der Aufgabenbeschreibung (Teil B der Vergabeunterlagen) Lösungsvorschläge für ein städtebauliches Konzept eines neuen Quartiers für Wohnen und Gewerbe erarbeiten, die von einem Beratungsgremium aus Sach- und Fachberatern aus den Bereichen Städtebau, Landschaftsarchitektur, Verkehrsplanung und Architektur, bewertet werden. Die Arbeitsgemeinschaft hat dieses als bevollmächtigte Vertretung zu benennen. Das Stadtplanungsbüro ist die alleinige Kontaktstelle im Rahmen des Verfahrens. Landschaftsarchitekten, Architekten und Verkehrsplaner können Partner / Nachunternehmer sein.

description: Am Bildungsstandort Eslohe befindet sich das zentrale Kompetenzzentrum des Dachdeckerhandwerks in Westfalen. Der Standort vereint die schulische Berufsausbildung, die Unterbringung der Auszubildenden, Verpflegungsangebote sowie Maßnahmen der Aus- und Weiterbildung in einem zusammenhängenden Campus. Die bestehende Gebäudeinfrastruktur stammt überwiegend aus den Jahren 1968 und 1985. Die vorhandenen Gebäude entsprechen sowohl hinsichtlich ihrer funktionalen Struktur als auch in Bezug auf die bauliche, energetische und nutzungsspezifische Qualität nicht mehr den heutigen Anforderungen an einen modernen Bildungs- und Internatsstandort. Insbesondere die bestehende Mischnutzung von Unterricht, Verwaltung, Wohnen und Verpflegung innerhalb der vorhandenen Gebäude führt zu organisatorischen Einschränkungen und erschwert eine zeitgemäße Umsetzung des Bildungsauftrags. Auch die Unterbringungssituation im Wohnheimbereich entspricht nicht mehr den aktuellen Anforderungen. Die derzeit überwiegend vorhandenen Mehrbettzimmer mit Gemeinschaftssanitäranlagen bieten nur eingeschränkte Aufenthalts- und Wohnqualität. Darüber hinaus bestehen Defizite bei den Freizeit-, Aufenthalts- und Kommunikationsflächen für die Auszubildenden. Im Rahmen einer Machbarkeitsstudie wurden verschiedene Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für den Standort untersucht. Auf Grundlage der Ergebnisse hat sich der Auftraggeber für die Realisierung eines Ersatzneubaukonzeptes entschieden. Damit sollen die funktionalen, organisatorischen, pädagogischen und energetischen Anforderungen langfristig erfüllt und gleichzeitig der laufende Schul- und Wohnheimbetrieb während der Realisierung sichergestellt werden.

title: Germany – Burglar-alarm system installation work – Stiftung Schloss Marienburg: Bauabschnitt 2.3 Vorgezogene Balkenkopfsanierung: Baustellenüberwachung - Videoüberwachung
description: Die Stiftung Schloss Marienburg beabsichtigt die Sanierung des Schlosses. Das Gebäude ist ein eingetragenes Baudenkmal. Die historische Bausubstanz ist zu schonen und zu erhalten. Die Erfordernisse aus dem Denkmalschutz verlangen von allen am Bau beteiligten Firmen eine besondere Vorsicht und Sorgfalt und eine enge Abstimmung mit der Bauleitung. Im Bauabschnitt 2.3 ist die Sanierung beschädigter Balkenköpfe in der Geschossdecke zwischen dem Obergeschoss und dem ersten Dachgeschoss des Ost-, West- und Südostflügels vorgesehen. Sanierung des denkmalgeschützten Schlosses Marienburg, Bauabschnitt 2.3 Balkenkopfsanierung - Baustellenüberwachung mittels einer mobilen Videoüberwachungsanlage zum Schutz des Baustellengeländes vor Diebstahl und Vandalismus. Die Leistungen umfassen insbesondere die Werkplanung einschließlich Festlegung der Kamerapositionen und Überwachungsbereiche, die Bereitstellung und Installation einer mobilen Videoüberwachungsanlage für die Außenbereiche sowie deren Vorhaltung und Betrieb über die vorgesehene Bauzeit von ca. 35 Wochen. Bestandteil der Leistungen sind die Aufschaltung und Fernsteuerung der Anlage, die durchgehende Überwachung außerhalb der Bauzeiten, die Alarmbearbeitung einschließlich Alarmprotokollierung und Einweisung von Interventionsdiensten sowie der abschließende Rückbau der Anlage. Die Ausführung erfolgt unter Berücksichtigung der besonderen örtlichen Gegebenheiten, der Anforderungen des Denkmalschutzes sowie der naturschutzrechtlichen Auflagen, insbesondere hinsichtlich der Beleuchtung und des Schutzes der angrenzenden Waldbereiche.

description: Die Außenstelle der Klaus-Groth-Schule im Ortsteil Schobüll (kurz Bornschool, nach der ursprünglichen Namensgebung) wird als einzügige Grundschule genutzt. Das Gebäude wurde 1962 errichtet und vom Husumer Architekten H.J. Feddersen für die damals noch selbstständige Gemeinde Schobüll geplant. 1992 wurde das Umkleidehaus (B. Nehls aus Schobüll) geplant. 2006 wurde das bisher geltende Brandschutzkonzept erstellt und daraufhin eine Außentreppe aus Stahl angebaut (Architekturbüro Reichardt & Bahnsen, Husum). Nun werden Umbaumaßnahmen für die "Offene Ganztagsschule" (OGTS) erforderlich, da ab August 2026 und damit ab dem Schuljahr 2026/27 im Land Schleswig-Holstein alle Kinder der ersten Jahrgangsstufe an Grundschulen einen Anspruch auf ganztägige Bildung und Betreuung haben. In den Folgejahren wird der Anspruch schrittweise auf die Jahrgangsstufen 2 bis 4 erweitert, so dass ab dem Schuljahr 2029/30 allen Kindern der ersten bis vierten Jahrgangsstufen der Rechtsanspruch zusteht. Zur Bereitstellung der Plätze in der Außenstelle der Klaus-Groth-Schule in Schobüll sind bauliche Maßnahmen am bestehenden Bauwerk erforderlich. Weitere Einzelheiten zum Leistungsbild sind der Projektbeschreibung innerhalb der Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

buyer: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
title: Germany – Business and management consultancy and related services – 10047662-Technical Services to Strengthen Integrated, Inclusive and Climate Justice-Oriented Urban Development in Brazil
description: In Brazil, 87.4% of the population lives in urban areas, according to the 2022 Census of the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE), concentrating both the challenges and opportunities of sustainable urban development. Territorial inequalities remain significant: urban peripheries and Amazonian cities face more limited access to sanitation, drainage, and mobility, while also being more exposed to extreme weather events and increasing pressure on ecosystems. In Brazil"s North region, only 46.4% of the population has access to adequate wastewater services, even though approximately 70% of the Amazonian population lives in urban areas. In addition, nearly 20% of residents in favelas and informal settlements live on streets without vehicle access, compared to only 1.4% outside these areas. More than half of these residents also lack access to urban drainage infrastructure. The bilateral BMZ cooperation project "Sustainable Urban Development in Brazil III" (DUS III), implemented by GIZ in partnership with the Ministry of Cities (MCID), expands the results of its previous phase (DUS II) by scaling the Integrated Urban Development (IUD) approach in priority territories, with a particular focus on urban peripheries and Amazonian cities. The project promotes the integration of sectoral policies, including housing, mobility, sanitation, environment, and economic development, while aligning planning, financing, and implementation process. It also strengthens coordination across levels of government and applies a place-based approach to generate urban, social, economic, and environmental impacts. Its objective is to expand access to infrastructure and services, reduce climate vulnerabilities, and promote social participation in urban decision-making, thereby contributing to inclusion, economic dynamism, and climate justice in Brazilian cities. GIZ intends to contract services to structurally strengthen a socio-economic and climate resilient just transition in Amazonian cities and urban peripheries in Brazil, at both national and subnational levels, supporting: 1. Integrated and inclusive urban development to promote economic opportunities in Amazonian cities. 2. Integrated and inclusive urban development in urban peripheries; and 3. Support national programmes and governance structures to replicate local approaches.

title: Germany – Supporting services for the government – Schlussabrechnungen und weitere Unterstützung Corona-Wirtschaftshilfen
description: Gegenstand und Ziel des vorliegenden Vergabeverfahrens ist die Erbringung verschiedenartiger Leistungen des Auftragnehmers zur Unterstützung des Auftraggebers und insbesondere dessen Bezirksregierungen bei (1) der Prüfung, Bearbeitung und Bescheidung von Anträgen bzw. Schluss- und Endabrechnungen auf Wirtschaftshilfen im Zusammenhang mit der Corona-Pandemie sowie (2) allen weiteren Aufgaben des Auftraggebers und insbesondere der Bezirksregierungen, die im Rahmen der Administration und Abwicklung der coronabedingten Wirtschaftshilfeprogramme entstehen. Nachfolgend sind insofern unter Ziffer IV. dieser Leistungsbeschreibung die typischen Aufgaben und Leistungen des Auftragnehmers dargestellt, die den Kern der Unterstützungsleistungen des Auftragsnehmers ausmachen werden, auf die jedoch die Leistungen des Auftragnehmers bei Abruf der Leistungen nicht beschränkt sind, es sei denn, der Auftraggeber hat eine Beschränkung auf bestimmte Leistungen im Einzelabruf vorgesehen (vgl. insofern auch Ziffern 1 und 4 des Rahmenvereinbarungstextes sowie Anlage 1.2 zur Rahmenvereinbarung). Der Auftraggeber hat aktuell seine fünf Bezirksregierungen als Bewilligungsbehörde mit der Verwaltung und Abwicklung der Corona-Wirtschaftshilfen sowie der NRW-Soforthilfe 2020 (gemeinsam auch als "coronabedingte Wirtschaftshilfen-Programme") beauftragt. Der Auftragnehmer erbringt seine Leistungen sowohl für den Auftraggeber und insbesondere die jeweils zuständige Bezirksregierung des Landes Nordrhein-Westfalens als aktuelle Bewilligungsbehörden - im vorliegenden Los 1 primär für die Bezirksregierungen Arnsberg, Düsseldorf und Münster -, als auch ggf. andere vom Auftraggeber benannte Dritte. Der Auftragnehmer ist verpflichtet, im Rahmen der Leistungserbringung mit allen vom Auftraggeber benannten Behörden und sonstigen Dritten zusammenzuarbeiten, die Aufgaben und Leistungen im Zusammenhang mit coronabedingten Wirtschaftshilfen-Programmen erbringen, wenn und soweit der Auftraggeber dies vom Auftragnehmer verlangt. Dies gilt insbesondere für (1) vom Auftraggeber bestimmte juristische Berater, (2) ggf. weitere für die bisherigen Bewilligungsarbeiten aus der bisherigen Antragsphase noch tätige Dienstleister des Auftraggebers bzw. der Bezirksregierungen oder der Bundesrepublik Deutschland ("Bund") und (3) dem bzw. den Dienstleistern, die ggf. im Rahmen eines losübergreifenden Projektmanagements und Prüfung eingesetzt werden.

title: Denmark – Relocation services – Rammeaftale om flytteydelser
description: Udbudsprocessen omfatter en aftale med Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen (ETK) om levering af flytteydelser. ETK udbyder flytteydelser på Forsvarets etablissementer, forstået som flytning imellem etablissementer, på etablissementer, nedtagning samt opbevaring. Flytteydelser kan ligeledes indebære, nedtagning, udpakning og opsætning af kontorpladser fordelt på fem (5) regionale delaftaler. Det nærmere indhold og omfang af ydelserne fremgår af Rammeaftalen. Flytteydelser vil skulle udføres på Forsvarets lokationer som fremgår af Aftalebilag 2 - Etablissement oversigt. Antallet af etablissementer vil kunne ændre sig i aftaleperioden. Udbuddet er opdelt geografisk i følgende fem (5) delaftaler: Delaftale 1: Region Nordjylland Delaftale 2: Region Midtjylland Delaftale 3: Region Syddanmark Delaftale 4: Region Sjælland Delaftale 5: Region Hovedstaden Delaftalerne er opdelt geografisk, for at gøre det muligt for mindre og mellemstore lokale virksomheder at byde på opgaven. Der kan afgives tilbud på en eller flere af de udbudte delaftaler. Tilbudsgiver skal i ESPD del ll.A. angive, hvilke delaftaler I ønsker at afgive tilbud på. Der skal afleveres et (1) tilbud per delaftale, som Tilbudsgiver ønsker at afgive tilbud på. Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen gør opmærksom på, at det er muligt for en Tilbudsgiver at få tildelt alle delaftaler. Rammeaftalen tildeles to Leverandører, som rangeres på en kaskade på baggrund af ETK's tilbudsevaluering, jf. udbudsbetingelsernes pkt. 4. Konkrete ordrer på Rammeaftalen bliver tildelt som følger: Ordrer tildeles den første Leverandør i kaskaden. Såfremt denne Leverandør ikke kan udføre ordren indenfor den fastsatte frist jf. pkt. 9.1, vil den anden Leverandør i kaskaden blive tildelt ordren. Det estimeres, at Rammeaftalen har en økonomisk værdi på 24 mio. i den samlede kon-traktperiode. Værdien er alene udtryk for ETK’s bedste skøn på udbudstidspunktet, der baserer sig på tidligere indkøb samt kommende forventede indkøb. Skønnet er ikke bindende for ETK eller udtryk for en garanteret minimumsomsætning for Leverandøren. ETK har således ikke pligt til at aftage en bestemt mængde. Rammeaftalens maksimale økonomiske værdi i den samlede kontraktperiode udgør i alt 48 mio. DKK. Det maksimale økonomiske omfang udgør en ret til for ETK at købe via Rammeaftalen uanset indkøbsvolumen måtte overstige den estimerede værdi. Den maksimale økonomiske værdi er et udtryk for en samlet økonomisk værdi for alle delaftalerne og benyttes derfor på tværs af delaftalerne. Rammeaftalen ophører uden varsel, såfremt den maksimale værdi overskrides forud for kontraktperiodens ophør. Årsagen til Rammeaftalens maksimale værdi er risikoen for, at ETK’s fremtidige behov over-stiger det på udbudstidspunktet estimerede behov særligt henset til den øgede økonomi og aktivitetsniveau i Forsvaret som følge af Forsvarsforliget for 2024-2033, Aftale om styrkelse af Forsvarets kampkraft af 22. februar 2025 og den nuværende sikkerhedspolitiske situation.

title: Industry Feedback Requested: Fort Worth District Draft Division 01 Specification for Other Transaction Authority Process
description: Federal Organization Issuing Notice: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Fort Worth District, Contracting Division DESCRIPTION The Fort Worth District is requesting industry feedback on draft Division 01 Specification revisions for construction projects utilizing an Other Transaction Authority (OTA) procurement method. What is an Other Transaction? An Other Transaction (OT) is a legally binding agreement entered into by the Government under specific statutory authority. OTs are not procurement contracts and are not subject to the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR). Title 10 U.S.C. � 2808a authorizes the use of OTs for certain facility construction and repair projects. The executed OT Agreement establishes the terms, conditions, responsibilities, and performance requirements applicable to the project. HOW TO PROVIDE FEEDBACK: Industry responses and/or feedback are to be submitted via "Bidder Inquiry" in ProjNet (https://www.projnet.org) no later than 1700 CT on November 19, 2026. Respondents shall not submit proprietary or sensitive information through the Bidder Inquiry module. The Fort Worth District is seeking industry feedback to improve upon and better align its approach with commercial practices. Revisions and redlines are left in the draft Division 01 documents to show Industry where the Fort Worth District is currently streamlining this division and the changes that are being considered. Industry comments and feedback received will be used to refine the draft documents. The attachment provided for industry feedback is for informational purposes only. The Fort Worth District does not intend to respond to questions but will consider all comments and feedback received for future updates to the Division 01 Specifications. Website: https://www.projnet.org BIDDER INQUIRY KEY: HDR42I-G8MAJ9 Specific Instructions for Initial ProjNet Bid Inquiry Access: From the ProjNet home page, click on "Quick Add" on the upper right side of the screen. Identify the Agency as USACE. Key - Enter the Bidder Inquiry Key listed above. Email - Enter the email address you would like to use for communication. Click "Continue." A page will then open saying that a user account was not found and will ask you to create one using the provided form. Enter your First Name, Last Name, Company, City, State, Phone, Email, Secret Question, Secret Answer, and Time Zone. Remember your Secret Question and Answer as they will be used from this point on to access the ProjNet system. Click "Add User." Once this is completed you are now registered within ProjNet and are currently logged into the system. Specific Instructions for Subsequent ProjNet Bid Inquiry Access: Steps 1 through 3 - Same as Above. Enter the email address you used to register previously in ProjNet. Click "Continue." A page will then open asking for the answer to your Secret Question. Enter your Secret Answer and click "Login." Once this is completed, you are logged into the system

title: F138-100 engine sustainment
description: 1. Purpose Amendment 0001: The purpose of this amendment is to extend the response deadline to 19 November 2026/ 5 Pm CST to allow for additional industry feedback. This is a Sources Sought Synopsis issued for market research purposes only. This notice is not a solicitation, request for proposal, request for quotation, invitation for bid, or commitment by the Government to award a contract. The Government will not pay for any information, costs, or responses submitted in response to this notice. No solicitation is available at this time, and the Government does not intend to award a contract based solely on responses to this announcement. The Government may contact respondents to obtain additional information regarding their capabilities. 2. Requirement Description The Department of the Air Force is conducting market research to identify capable sources for a potential follow-on requirement for F138-100 engine sustainment supporting C-5M aircraft mission requirements. The current F138-100 Engine Sustainment contract is an indefinite delivery, indefinite-quantity service contract. The current contract was competitively awarded to Canadian Commercial Corporation. The anticipated requirement may include material management, engine maintenance, component support, engineering, airworthiness, and related sustainment services. The Government has not determined the acquisition strategy, contract type, period of performance, competition approach, or socioeconomic set-aside approach for any future requirement. 3. Anticipated Scope Interested parties should demonstrate their capability to perform some or all of the following functions: Provide material-management functions, engine maintenance, and subcontractor component-support services. Provide supply liaison support and depot-level maintenance and repair capability, including required equipment and tooling. Develop and update maintenance build plans using Reliability Centered Maintenance Plus principles. Comply with applicable Technical Order data and Time Compliance Technical Orders, including new or revised technical requirements. Support engineering investigations. Support Product Quality Deficiency Reports. Provide analytical condition inspections. Manage and use Government-furnished property, including Government-owned parts and equipment, as authorized and made available by the Government. Support and maintain certifications and compliance associated with airworthiness requirements. Integrate and coordinate peculiar support equipment. 4. Requested Capability Information Interested parties are requested to submit a concise capabilities statement addressing the following: a. Company Information Company name. Unique Entity Identifier. Commercial and Government Entity code, if available. Company address. Primary point of contact, including name, title, telephone number, and email address. Applicable NAICS codes listed in the company�s System for Award Management registration. Business size and socioeconomic status for NAICS 336412, including, as applicable: Small business; Small disadvantaged business; 8(a) participant; Women-owned small business; Economically disadvantaged women-owned small business; HUBZone small business; Service-disabled veteran-owned small business; Veteran-owned small business; or Other than small business. b. Technical Capability A description of the company�s capability to meet each anticipated scope area identified in Section 3. Identification of any scope areas the company cannot perform. Description of facilities, equipment, tooling, technical data access, quality systems, certifications, and workforce qualifications relevant to F138-100 or comparable military/commercial aircraft engine sustainment. Description of experience supporting airworthiness, technical-order compliance, engineering investigations, product quality deficiency reporting, and analytical condition inspections. c. Relevant Experience For each relevant effort performed within the past five years, provide: Customer name and contract number, if releasable; Period of performance; Brief description of work performed; Relevance to the anticipated requirement; Contract value or value range, if releasable; Prime contractor or subcontractor role; and Customer point of contact, if authorized for release. d. Teaming and Subcontracting Respondents proposing to use teaming arrangements or subcontractors should identify: Proposed prime contractor and each known teammate or subcontractor; Anticipated roles and scope allocation; Whether each entity is small or other than small business; Relevant prior teaming experience; and Any limitations, dependencies, or approvals affecting the arrangement. e. Small-Business Participation All respondents are requested to provide a reasonable estimate of anticipated small-business utilization as a percentage of total contract value, with supporting rationale. Identify the anticipated supplies or services suitable for small-business participation and the socioeconomic categories expected to be utilized. If a small business intends to compete as a prime contractor under a potential small-business set-aside, it should describe its planned approach to complying with applicable limitations on subcontracting, including: The anticipated percentage of contract performance to be performed by the prime contractor and similarly situated entities; The anticipated percentage of payments to be made to subcontractors that are not similarly situated entities; The anticipated division of work among teaming partners and subcontractors; and The basis for concluding that the proposed performance approach is achievable. Other than small businesses should also describe their anticipated approach to small-business subcontracting and their experience meeting small-business subcontracting commitments on comparable efforts. 5. Acquisition Strategy The Government has not determined an acquisition strategy for this potential requirement. Information received in response to this notice will be used to assess the availability and capability of industry sources and to inform potential competition and small-business participation strategies. The Government may consider full and open competition, a socioeconomic set-aside, or another acquisition approach, as appropriate. Nothing in this notice constitutes a commitment by the Government regarding any future acquisition strategy.

title: Electrical Projects � Use of Progressive Design Build (PDB) with Other Transaction Authority (OTA) - Request for Information
description: This is a request for information (RFI) for market intelligence and for informational purposes only. This announcement does not constitute a solicitation or a request for proposal (RFP), and no solicitation is currently available. Participation in this RFI is strictly voluntary. The Government will not be obligated to award any agreement or contract because of this RFI, nor will it reimburse respondents for any costs associated with the preparation or submission of information. Submitting a response will not affect a firm�s ability to submit a proposal should a formal solicitation be issued in the future. Please note that while Other Transaction Authority is not subject to FAR based small business regulations, this NAICS code is provided for market research to help the Government understand the size and demographics of the interested industrial base. PROGRAM/PROJECT OVERVIEW: The U.S. Air Force 377th Contracting Division has a requirement to execute the construction and technical redesign requirements for the demolition of three substations and new construction of two upgraded substations. The services requested will include new 12.47 kV distribution systems. The primary purpose and objective of these projects are to rapidly upgrade the existing infrastructure, meet standards, enhance operational efficiency, and ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines. The Government is evaluating the feasibility of executing these requirements under one award via Progressive Design-Build (PDB) utilizing an Other Transaction (OT) Agreement under the statutory authority of 10 U.S.C. � 2808a. Summaries of projects for this acquisition strategy are as follows: - MHMV200009 � Repair Substation 9 and Feeders: The primary objective of the Repair Substation 9 and Feeders project is to design and construct a fully operational, modern power distribution asset, upgrading the existing infrastructure to meet standards, enhance operational efficiency, and ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines. This goal will be achieved by establishing the new substation facility within a defined 100ft x 150ft footprint directly south of the existing location, and installing all-new substation components, security fencing, distribution poles, switching gear, and conductors. The project also aims to complete the systematic teardown and removal of all retired infrastructure to restore the original site. - MHMV 120009 � Remove Substation 23 & Connect Loads to Substation 24A Feeder 5: The project entails the design and construction services required to remove Substation 23 & connect loads to Substation 24A Feeder 5 located on KAFB. The primary purpose and objective of this project is to upgrade the existing infrastructure of Substation 24A Feeder 5 to meet standards, enhance operational efficiency, and ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines. - MHMV080002 � Demo Substation 3, Rebuild Substation 10 and Distribution System: The primary goal of the Demo Substation 3, Rebuild Substation 10 and Distribution System project is to safely decommission and demolish Substations 3 and 10 and design, construct, and commission a modern, consolidated Substation 10 rated at 10,000 KVA (10/12/14 MVA). This infrastructure upgrade will replace aged, unserviceable assets with a resilient, high-capacity substation and an underground distribution backbone designed to eliminate single points of failure and modernize base electrical infrastructure. Included in this notice are the attachments of the Scope of Services with technical documents for more detailed information on the nature of the work. INFORMATION REQUESTED: Interested industry partners are requested to respond to the following questions to help shape the final acquisition strategy. Please limit your responses to no more than 5-pages addressing the following questions � - Company Profile: Business Name Address Point of Contract (Name, Title) Phone Number Email Address Cage Code & UEI - Relevant Experience: Please provide your relevant experience as it relates to performing multiple project in similar size, scope, and complexity to this requirement. Summarize performance clearly and factually, along with project locations and the projects customer(s). Do not submit proprietary trade secrets, protected technologies, or classified information in your response. All feed-back received will be handled as public market research to shape the Government's final acquisition approach. - Feedback on the Acquisition Strategy & Alternatives: OTA Experience � Describe your firm�s previous experience, if any, executing projects utilizing OTA. What project characteristics make PDB OTA particularly advantageous or disadvantageous for this requirement? Describe your experience executing Progressive Design-Build, Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR), or other highly collaborative delivery methods where designer and builder worked collaboratively with the owner before locking in a Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP). Does the proposed PDB-OTA strategy incentivize your firm to participate? Why or why not? Are there alternative acquisition strategies, commercial phasing arrangements, or risk-sharing terms that the Government has not considered that would yield a higher quality facility, faster delivery, or lower cost? The Government welcomes candid industry feedback and recommendations regarding commercial practices, agreement terms, project phasing, risk sharing, governance, pricing approaches, and other considerations that could improve successful execution of these projects under 10 U.S.C. � 2808a. Interested firms are encouraged to add themselves to the Interested Vendors List associated with this announcement on SAM.gov to receive future updates. Please submit your responses to the Government Point of Contact listed below by the response date listed.

title: Pleno de la Mancomunidad Forestal Ansó-Fago
description: Primero. La Asamblea General de la Mancomunidad Forestal Ansó-Fago aprobó el proyecto de instalación de una nueva estación depuradora de aguas residuales para el Camping Zuriza. Posteriormente se incorporó la documentación técnica de subsanación revisada favorablemente por la Diputación Provincial de Huesca y la Presidencia aprobó el proyecto técnico corregido, con un presupuesto base de licitación de 128.505,55 euros, IVA excluido, y 155.491,72 euros, IVA incluido. Segundo. Por Resolución de Presidencia se aprobó el expediente de contratación, el gasto, el Pliego de Cláusulas Administrativas Particulares, la licitación mediante procedimiento abierto y la tramitación urgente. Se fijó el precio como único criterio de adjudicación. Tercero. Finalizado el plazo de presentación de proposiciones el 4 de septiembre de 2026, consta una única oferta, presentada dentro de plazo por VITAQUA DEPURACIÓN DE AGUAS, S.L., con NIF B82573312. Cuarto. La Mesa de Contratación, reunida el 8 de septiembre de 2026, calificó favorablemente la declaración responsable, admitió a la licitadora, abrió el archivo electrónico B y valoró la oferta. La proposición obtuvo 100 puntos, no se encuentra incursa en presunción de anormalidad y quedó clasificada en primer y único lugar. La Mesa propuso la adjudicación a su favor. Quinto. Aceptada la propuesta, se practicó mediante la Plataforma de Contratación del Sector Público el requerimiento previo del artículo 150.2 de la Ley 9/2017, de 8 de noviembre, de Contratos del Sector Público. La empresa lo cumplimentó dentro del plazo concedido. Sexto. Constan en el expediente el certificado del Registro Oficial de Licitadores y Empresas Clasificadas del Sector Público; los certificados positivos de la Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria y de la Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social; el justificante del Impuesto sobre Actividades Económicas; y la diligencia de Secretaría-Intervención que acredita el cumplimiento del requerimiento. La clasificación K-8, categoría 3, acredita la solvencia exigida en el Pliego. Séptimo. La garantía definitiva se constituyó mediante certificado de seguro de caución de CESCE número 2026/96648, integrante de la póliza abierta número 1007833, expedido el 11 de septiembre de 2026 por 6.206,82 euros, equivalente al 5 por ciento del precio ofertado, IVA excluido. Octavo. Mediante Resolución de Presidencia de 12 de septiembre de 2026 se aprobó el expediente 1895790R de generación de crédito en el presupuesto prorrogado por 155.491,71 euros. Contabilizada la modificación, existe crédito adecuado y suficiente en la aplicación 4390/62300, “Instalación EDAR Camping Zuriza”. Consta incorporado el documento contable de retención de crédito por 150.205,00 euros. Noveno. La Secretaria-Interventora emitió el 12 de septiembre de 2026 informe favorable de fiscalización previa de la adjudicación y de la disposición del gasto por 150.205,00 euros, sin formular reparo.

title: Empresa de Transformación Agraria S.A.,S.M.E., M.P., (TRAGSA)
description: Declaración responsable firmada electrónicamente por el representante legal de la empresa licitadora en la que se comprometa a aportar (en caso de ser la empresa mejor calificada), las fichas técnicas o documentos relativos al objeto a contratar, donde se justifique el cumplimiento de las especificaciones indicadas en el pliego de prescripciones técnicas. (Anexo. Declaración Cumplimiento). La ficha técnica o documento relativos al objeto a contratar, deberá contener como mínimo las siguientes especificaciones técnicas: - Marca y modelo - Nº Bastidor/matrícula - Potencia (CV) - Implementos Para generar el archivo se utilizará la plantilla ANEXO. DECLARACION CUMPLIMIENTO debidamente cumplimentada. La presentación se realizará a través de la herramienta de preparación y presentación de ofertas de la PLACSP.
